title: 第6单元：个人防护装备
source_doc: course/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/07_Module 6 — Personal Protective Equipment.md
author_source: project/Acids, Bases & Solvents Safety/07_Module 6 — Personal Protective Equipment/src.py

points.K1: 选错防护比不戴更危险
points.K7: 安全眼镜不等于护目镜
points.K8: 倾倒浓酸：护目镜加面罩
points.K15: 高能化学工作穿阻燃服

shots.scene: 欣欣穿着实验服、戴护目镜和手套，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a lab coat, safety goggles and gloves waves at the camera in a bright lab.
shots.narration: 这一课讲个人防护：选对、穿对、脱对。
overlay: 个人防护装备：选对、穿对、脱对

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、实验服、口罩四个图标从头到手排成一列
shots.prompt_en: Four icons stacked from top to bottom: safety goggles, a respirator mask, a lab coat and a pair of gloves. No people.
shots.narration: 从眼睛、口鼻、身体到双手，一样样看。

shots.scene: 阿杰戴着普通眼镜和薄手套，准备在通风橱里倒一大瓶酸
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wearing ordinary safety glasses and thin disposable gloves reaches for a large blank-labeled acid bottle inside a fume hood.
shots.narration: 阿杰戴着平光眼镜，准备倒一大瓶浓酸。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，手里拿着密封护目镜和面罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and holds up sealed splash goggles and a face shield.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：这副眼镜挡不住飞溅。

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，看着自己的眼镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking at his glasses and thin gloves.
shots.narration: 阿杰不解：我明明戴了防护啊？

shots.scene: 欣欣站在空白白板前竖起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 戴了不等于戴对，这正是今天的重点。

shots.section_title: 选错防护比不戴更危险
shots.scene: 眼镜图标旁有个虚线盾牌，盾牌有裂缝
shots.prompt_en: An icon of plain glasses beside a dashed outline shield with a crack running through it. No people.
shots.narration: 选错防护，比不戴还危险。
overlay: 选错防护比不戴更危险

shots.section_title: 选错防护比不戴更危险
shots.scene: 一个人形图标戴着错误装备，头顶冒出放心的笑脸气泡，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram in mismatched gear with a relaxed smiley thought bubble, next to a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 因为它让人误以为自己很安全。

shots.section_title: 选错防护比不戴更危险
shots.scene: 危害图标和防护图标像拼图一样严丝合缝
shots.prompt_en: A hazard pictogram and a protective gear icon fitting together like matching puzzle pieces with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 防护必须和具体危害对得上。

shots.scene: 层层防线示意：最外是通风橱，最里是人身上的防护
shots.prompt_en: Concentric layers icon: a fume hood on the outer ring, a procedure sheet in the middle, and a person with goggles and gloves at the center. No people.
shots.narration: 个人防护，是最后一道防线。

shots.scene: 通风橱图标出现故障叉号，只剩人身上的护具挡在前面
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood icon with a red fault cross; only a shield icon with goggles and gloves stands between a person pictogram and a splash. No people.
shots.narration: 通风橱一旦失灵，只剩它挡在前面。

shots.scene: 空白检查表上一路打勾，旁边的人却没戴好护目镜
shots.prompt_en: A blank checklist being ticked quickly, while a person pictogram beside it has goggles pushed up on the forehead. No people.
shots.narration: 把选防护当成打勾走过场，

shots.scene: 舞台幕布图标前站着全副武装的人形，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A theater stage curtain icon with a fully geared person pictogram posing on stage, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 只是一场安全表演，护不住人。

shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白评估表，和老周站在实验台前
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank assessment form and talks with the older man at a lab bench.
shots.narration: 选防护，先做书面的危害评估。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓图上眼睛、手、躯干、口鼻依次高亮
shots.prompt_en: A simple body outline diagram with the eyes, hands, torso and nose and mouth highlighted one after another. No people.
shots.narration: 找出具体危害，和哪个部位会受伤。

shots.scene: 一堆随手抓来的护具图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A random pile of mismatched protective gear icons crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 凭感觉乱配，反而带来新危险。

shots.scene: 阿杰穿着过大的实验服、松垮的手套，满头大汗
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears an oversized lab coat and loose baggy gloves, sweating heavily.
shots.narration: 护具不合身、太闷热，人就容易出错。

shots.scene: 温度计、水滴、疲惫表情三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a rising thermometer, a water drop, and a tired face. No people.
shots.narration: 过热、脱水、厌烦，都会让人犯错。

shots.scene: 小研帮阿杰换上合身的实验服和手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student helps the young male student change into a well-fitting lab coat and properly sized gloves.
shots.narration: 让防护好穿，和选对型号一样重要。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一副护目镜，凑近看镜框侧面
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a pair of safety goggles and looks closely at the side of the frame.
shots.narration: 眼护具不能只看样子。

shots.scene: 护目镜镜框特写，放大镜对准一处空白标识区
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a goggle frame with a magnifying glass over a small blank marking area. No people.
shots.narration: 按美国眼护具标准，查看镜框标识。

shots.section_title: 安全眼镜不等于护目镜
shots.scene: 左边安全眼镜图标，右边密封护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Side by side icons: safety glasses with side shields on the left, sealed splash goggles on the right. No people.
shots.narration: 安全眼镜和护目镜，不能互相代替。
overlay: 安全眼镜不等于护目镜

shots.section_title: 安全眼镜不等于护目镜
shots.scene: 飞来的碎屑被眼镜挡住；液滴从眼镜上下缝隙钻进去
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a flying chip blocked by safety glasses with a green check, and liquid droplets slipping in through gaps above and below the glasses with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全眼镜主要防冲击，挡不住液体。

shots.section_title: 安全眼镜不等于护目镜
shots.scene: 护目镜紧贴面部，液滴被挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: An icon of sealed indirect-vent goggles fitting snugly against a face outline, with droplets bouncing off. No people.
shots.narration: 防化学飞溅，要用贴合面部的护目镜。

shots.section_title: 倾倒浓酸：护目镜加面罩
shots.scene: 小研在通风橱前，看着一大瓶空白标签的酸和一只烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands at a fume hood looking at a large blank-labeled acid bottle and an empty beaker.
shots.narration: 在通风橱里从4升大瓶倒浓硝酸，
overlay: 倾倒浓酸：护目镜加面罩

shots.section_title: 倾倒浓酸：护目镜加面罩
shots.scene: 飞溅图标，旁边安全眼镜被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A splash pictogram next to an icon of safety glasses crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 这是飞溅作业，安全眼镜不够。

shots.section_title: 倾倒浓酸：护目镜加面罩
shots.scene: 小研戴好密封护目镜，再罩上长及下巴的面罩
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on sealed splash goggles and then a chin-length face shield over them.
shots.narration: 要戴密封护目镜，外面再加面罩。

shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和通道畅通的示意图
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station, with a clear unobstructed path drawn on the floor leading to it. No people.
shots.narration: 万一溅进眼睛，10秒内要到洗眼器。

shots.scene: 通道上堆着箱子的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of boxes piled in the path to an eyewash station, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 去洗眼器的路，平时就不能堵。

shots.scene: 阿杰在洗眼器前冲洗双眼，小研在旁扶着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student rinses both eyes at an eyewash station while the female graduate student supports him.
shots.narration: 撑开眼睑，温水持续冲洗15分钟。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着护目镜点头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a pair of sealed goggles and nods.
shots.narration: 一开始选对护目镜，就不用受这份罪。

shots.scene: 一盒一次性丁腈手套，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: A box of disposable nitrile gloves with a large question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 很多人一律戴一次性丁腈手套。

shots.scene: 一只手套挡着各种化学品瓶图标，部分被红叉
shots.prompt_en: One glove icon in front of many blank chemical bottle icons; some of the bottles are marked with red crosses. No people.
shots.narration: 以为它什么都能挡，这个想法会要命。

shots.scene: 四种颜色不同的手套图标排成一排
shots.prompt_en: Four glove icons in different colors and thicknesses lined up in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 不同材质的手套，耐的化学品不同。

shots.scene: 丁腈手套碰到溶剂瓶后表面起皱溶胀
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a nitrile glove touching a blank solvent bottle and its surface wrinkling and swelling. No people.
shots.narration: 丁腈适合偶然接触，遇酮类氯代溶剂易坏。

shots.scene: 小研对照一张空白兼容性表格和一本空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares a blank compatibility chart with a blank safety data sheet booklet.
shots.narration: 要查兼容性表，核对穿透时间。

shots.scene: 一只手套伸向一盆液体的示意，旁边问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a gloved hand reaching toward a basin of liquid with a question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 如果要把手浸在二氯甲烷里几分钟，

shots.scene: 液滴穿过薄手套到达皮肤的剖面示意，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section icon of liquid passing through a thin glove layer to the skin, marked with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 普通丁腈几分钟就会被渗透。

shots.scene: 厚实的专用手套图标打上绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A thick specialty chemical-resistant glove icon with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 浸泡作业，必须换专用材质手套。

shots.scene: 内外两层手套的剖面示意
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section icon of two glove layers: an inner laminate layer and an outer nitrile layer. No people.
shots.narration: 长时间用苄氯这类致癌物，戴双层。

shots.scene: 外层手套破了口，内层仍完整保护皮肤
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the outer glove torn while the inner glove stays intact and the skin beneath is protected with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 外层被破坏时，内层还能护住皮肤。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁一只手套，表示按时更换
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass icon beside a glove with a circular replace arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 丁腈单独用，穿透时间很短。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起戴手套的双手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises both gloved hands toward the camera.
shots.narration: 手套戴对了，还要脱对。

shots.scene: 捏住指尖往下拽的手势图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand pinching the fingertips of a dirty glove and yanking it off, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 捏着指尖拽，污染瞬间就到了手上。

shots.scene: 第一步：从手腕处捏住外侧往下翻剥
shots.prompt_en: Step one icon: a gloved hand pinches the outside of the other glove at the wrist and peels it down inside out. No people.
shots.narration: 第一步，捏住腕部外侧，翻着剥下。

shots.scene: 第二步：把脱下的手套团在另一只手心
shots.prompt_en: Step two icon: the removed glove balled up in the palm of the still-gloved hand. No people.
shots.narration: 第二步，把它团在另一只手里。

shots.scene: 第三步：裸手手指伸进另一只手套的袖口内侧
shots.prompt_en: Step three icon: bare fingers slide under the cuff on the inside of the remaining glove. No people.
shots.narration: 第三步，裸手手指伸进袖口内侧。

shots.scene: 第四步：向外翻转剥下，把第一只包在里面
shots.prompt_en: Step four icon: the glove is peeled off inside out, wrapping the first glove inside, then dropped into a waste bin. No people.
shots.narration: 翻转剥下，把第一只包在里面。

shots.scene: 阿杰对着空白流程卡练习脱手套，然后洗手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student practices removing gloves step by step in front of a blank poster, then washes his hands at a sink.
shots.narration: 平时多练几遍，脱完记得洗手。

shots.section_title: 高能化学工作穿阻燃服
shots.scene: 两件实验服：一件着火持续燃烧，一件离火熄灭
shots.prompt_en: Two lab coat icons: a cotton coat with flames that keep burning, and a flame-resistant coat where the flame goes out. No people.
shots.narration: 实验服的面料，关键时刻关乎性命。
overlay: 高能化学工作穿阻燃服

shots.section_title: 高能化学工作穿阻燃服
shots.scene: 火焰图标贴近棉质实验服，火势蔓延
shots.prompt_en: A flame icon touches a cotton lab coat icon and the fire spreads across it. No people.
shots.narration: 普通棉质实验服遇火，会持续燃烧。

shots.section_title: 高能化学工作穿阻燃服
shots.scene: 自燃标识、明火和高能反应三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a flame-over-circle hazard pictogram, an open flame burner, and an exploding reaction flask symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 用自燃试剂、明火或高能反应时，

shots.section_title: 高能化学工作穿阻燃服
shots.scene: 小研穿上阻燃实验服，扣好全部扣子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on a flame-resistant lab coat and fastens all the buttons.
shots.narration: 必须穿阻燃实验服，它能离火自熄。

shots.scene: 一件毛衣图标起火，旁边警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a synthetic sweater catching fire with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 2008年，美国一所高校研究人员起火，

shots.scene: 空着的阻燃服挂钩，被红圈标出
shots.prompt_en: An empty coat hook with a flame-resistant lab coat missing, circled in red. No people.
shots.narration: 她穿着化纤毛衣，没穿阻燃服。

shots.scene: 烧伤的人形图标和低头默哀的欣欣
shots.prompt_en: A bandaged person pictogram beside the panda mascot bowing its head solemnly.
shots.narration: 严重烧伤，最终不治。

shots.scene: 阻燃实验服图标打上绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A flame-resistant lab coat icon with a green check and a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 从此，这类工作阻燃服成了标配。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着口罩，身旁浮现四张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a respirator mask stands beside four floating blank cards.
shots.narration: 呼吸防护，不是发个口罩就完事。

shots.scene: 四张卡片用箭头连成一个流程
shots.prompt_en: Four blank cards linked by arrows into a process flow. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、体检、检验、培训，环环相扣。

shots.scene: 阿杰向王老师要一只防尘口罩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student asks the safety administrator for a disposable dust mask.
shots.narration: 阿杰想自己戴个防尘口罩。

shots.scene: 王老师递给他口罩，同时递上一张空白须知
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator hands him a dust mask together with a blank instruction sheet.
shots.narration: 自愿使用也要管，至少给书面须知。

shots.scene: 口罩挂在脖子上沾满粉尘的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dust-covered mask hanging around a neck, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 别让口罩妨碍操作，或变成污染源。

shots.scene: 紧密型面罩贴合面部的示意，周边一圈绿色
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tight-fitting half-face respirator sealed on a face outline with a green ring around the seal. No people.
shots.narration: 紧密型面罩，用前要做适合性检验。

shots.scene: 日历图标标出首次和定期
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon with two marked dates labeled by check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 首次使用前做，之后每年一次。

shots.scene: 胡须、体重秤、牙齿、疤痕四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a beard, a weighing scale, a tooth, and a small scar. No people.
shots.narration: 蓄须剃须、胖瘦变化，都会漏气。

shots.scene: 面罩边缘出现漏气小箭头，旁边重测图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of air leaking around the edge of a respirator seal with a circular retest arrow beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 面部有变化，必须重新检验再用。

shots.scene: 听诊器和空白体检表图标
shots.prompt_en: A stethoscope icon next to a blank medical form on a clipboard. No people.
shots.narration: 检验之前，先由医生做医学评估。

shots.scene: 老周戴半面罩打绿勾；较重的送风头罩打问号
shots.prompt_en: The older man wearing a half-face respirator with a green check beside him, and a heavy powered air helmet icon with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 高血压的老员工，半面罩可以用。

shots.scene: 心脏和温度计图标
shots.prompt_en: A heart icon and a thermometer icon side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 较重的送风呼吸器，可能就不宜。

shots.scene: 王老师在实验室里走动观察，手拿空白记录板
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks through the lab observing students at work, holding a blank clipboard.
shots.narration: 防护好不好，要在真实操作中看。

shots.scene: 一条偏离轨道的虚线被提早拉回
shots.prompt_en: A dashed line drifting off a straight track is pulled back early by a hand icon. No people.
shots.narration: 趁早发现偏离，别等出了事才知道。

shots.scene: 四个常见失效图标依次出现并打叉
shots.prompt_en: Four icons appear one by one, each with a red X: a single nitrile glove, a contaminated hand, a skipped goggles icon, and a mask with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的几种失效，你中过招吗？

shots.scene: 阿杰只戴手套没戴护目镜，正要做一件小事
shots.prompt_en: The young male student starts a quick small task without goggles, only gloves on.
shots.narration: “就一分钟”，最容易不戴护目镜。

shots.scene: 小研递过护目镜，阿杰戴上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hands him safety goggles and he puts them on.
shots.narration: 再短的操作，防护也不能省。

shots.scene: 货架上大中小各尺码的手套和实验服
shots.prompt_en: A storage shelf with gloves and lab coats in small, medium and large sizes, neatly labeled with blank tags. No people.
shots.narration: 尺码齐全、舒适合身，

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰愉快地穿戴防护
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student happily put on their goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 大家才愿意穿，也不想偷懒。

shots.scene: 时钟图标走过几个小时，人形图标越来越热
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon advancing several hours next to a person pictogram in full protective gear getting redder and sweatier. No people.
shots.narration: 研究生全套防护，连续干了几小时。

shots.scene: 人形图标头上冒出混乱的线团
shots.prompt_en: A sweating person pictogram with a tangled scribble cloud above its head. No people.
shots.narration: 过热让人头昏，判断力下降。

shots.scene: 漏掉一步、拿错瓶子的图标，冒出气体
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a skipped step on a blank checklist and a wrong bottle, with a gas cloud rising from a flask. No people.
shots.narration: 漏了一步、加错试剂，放出了气体。

shots.scene: 掀起面罩擦汗的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a person lifting a respirator to wipe sweat while gas is nearby, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 掀起面罩擦汗，当场吸入有害气体。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一条从温度计到警示三角的连锁箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a chain of arrows linking a thermometer icon to a warning triangle icon.
shots.narration: 身体难受，直接导致判断失误。

shots.scene: 欣欣对着镜子检查自己的护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot checks its own goggles and gloves in front of a mirror.
shots.narration: 看看你的防护：是真防护，还是表演？

shots.scene: 化学品瓶图标和护具图标用等号连起来
shots.prompt_en: A blank chemical bottle icon and a protective gear icon joined by an equals sign. No people.
shots.narration: 让它舒适好穿，始终按化学品匹配。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现评估表和人体轮廓图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a blank assessment form and a body outline.
shots.narration: 先评估危害，再按部位选防护。

shots.scene: 密封护目镜加面罩、洗眼器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of sealed goggles with a face shield and an eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 防飞溅戴护目镜加面罩，洗眼器要畅通。

shots.scene: 不同材质手套、双层手套和脱手套四步图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of gloves of different materials, a double glove cross-section and four doffing step arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 手套按化学品选，会戴更会脱。

shots.scene: 阻燃实验服和紧密型面罩图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a flame-resistant lab coat and a tight-fitting respirator, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 高能工作穿阻燃服，面罩先评估检验。

shots.scene: 各种尺码的合身护具图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of well-fitting gear in several sizes. No people.
shots.narration: 舒适合身，人们才愿意好好穿。

shots.scene: 欣欣全副防护，向镜头挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a lab coat, goggles and gloves waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 防护穿对了，安全才到位，下次见！
